name: Default
shortDescription: Web scraping and crawling API that turns websites into clean markdown or structured data, with a headless Chromium renderer, PostgreSQL job queue, Redis and RabbitMQ.

alerts.message: The self-hosted API has no authentication: anyone who knows the domain can run scrapes and crawls through your server. Keep the domain private or restrict access to it.
AI features such as JSON extraction and summaries need an OpenAI API key or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint in OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL.
